description: Custom evaluation cases. Each replays a public sample request with one input changed. Expected answers are derived by hand from the sample gold answer and the evidence (not from pipeline output). 'steps' entries are [operation, system_id, resource_id, evidence_id]; step_no, phase and state follow from the operation, and the order is canonical.

cases.tests: Time cutoff, other side: the same subject audited after the account reappeared.
cases.why: Gold case_27 is COMPLETE at 09-15. The 2026-09-17 bundle (evidence_02, captured 09-17T12:00) has an inner snapshot taken 09-17T12:00 that shows account_3866 ACTIVE again for user_27. Audited at 09-18, that copy is citable, so the account is a remaining record. The other resources keep their gold treatment as future checks.

cases.tests: Identity resolution from the subject's current email when the sample used the historical one.
cases.why: audit_284 changed user_29's email from noah.f438085@outlook.com to noah.f4380@outlook.com. Either address resolves to user_29, so the answer must equal gold case_29.
Email addresses match case-insensitively, so the answer must equal gold case_05.

change.request_text: Bitte löschen Sie mein Konto und alle damit verbundenen personenbezogenen Daten endgültig.

cases.tests: Request classification in a language that no sample or eval request uses (German).
cases.why: This is an unambiguous deletion request, so the answer must equal gold case_01.

change.request_text: Please send me a copy of all the personal data you hold about me. I want to keep using my account.

cases.tests: A non-deletion request for a subject whose data is really still present.
cases.why: An access request authorizes no deletion, so the answer is NOT_APPLICABLE with [] even though case_24's evidence shows a live account and search entry.

cases.tests: Early cutoff: only activity evidence exists yet, and later files must not be cited.
cases.why: At 09-07T10:00 the inventory snapshot that gold case_09 cites (evidence_93, 09-16) does not exist yet. The only citable proof of the restore risk is activity_3709 (09-07T09:51, CHECK_RESTORE_ACCESS: backup_4978 can still be restored). The account and audit record remain future checks as in gold.
